name: tower-data, the site's PostgreSQL database
location: AWS RDS instance tower-data (infra/aws/stacks/20-data.json; the schema in apps/web/src/platform/db/schema.ts)
personal_fields: rate_limit.key (the client IP in the sign-in rate limit's key)

backup.restore_proof: python -m tower_infra restore-check (infra/service/tower_infra/restore_check.py), on an instance restored by the account's owner
backup.note: Automated backups with point-in-time recovery, deletion protection and encryption on. Restore drilled on 2026-11-12 (docs/process/drills/2026-11-12-tower-data-restore.md): PITR into a temporary db.t4g.micro, restore-check counts identical to production; next drill due by 2027-02-10.

note: Decided by the owner on 2026-11-17 (Daniel, through the Torre, 17:36 BRT). The site stores no session IP or user agent and no identity-provider token: apps/web/src/identity/domain/privacy.ts nulls them before every write (minimizeSession, minimizeAccount), and the profile image too (minimizeUser).

processing.purpose: The learner's account and their progress in the lectures (Resume, Continue Watching, completion).
processing.legal_basis: Performance of a contract: the site's terms of use (LGPD art. 7, V).
processing.retention: While the account exists; deleted with it on the learner's request (answered within 15 days).

fields: rate_limit.key (the client IP in the sign-in rate limit's key)
processing.purpose: Security: limiting sign-in attempts to prevent abuse.
processing.legal_basis: Legitimate interest in the site's security (LGPD art. 7, IX).
processing.retention: At most 6 months, as the access records of the Marco Civil da Internet (Lei 12.965/2014, art. 15); the counters are short-lived.
